text: This staff report is about a matter for which Community Council has delegated authority to make a final decision, provided that it is not amended so that it varies with City policy or by-laws. Transportation Services is requesting North York Community Council to authorize amendments to the parking regulations on the south side of Old Orchard Grove, fronting Old Orchard Park. The proposed standing prohibition will prohibit motorists from parking in front of the walkway at Old Orchard Park and enhance sightlines and access for pedestrians using the park. The proposed changes will result in the loss of approximately three on-street parking spaces.
North York Community Council: 1. Prohibited standing at all times on the south side of Old Orchard Grove, between a point 22 metres east of Grey Road and a point 16.5 metres further east.
